title: Ban cap nhat v1.6.9 - Tu dong gan thiet bi vao dung ExpressVPN Group sau khi Change Device va doi 7s on dinh
releaseNotes:
- Tu dong goi API /v2/settings de gan dia chi MAC thiet bi vao dung ExpressVPN Group (Tunnel) sau khi Change Device
- May 1 mac dinh o Group 0 (Home), may 2..5 tu dong vao dung Group tuong ung
- Cho 7 giay on dinh mang sau khi vao Group moi roi check IP va tiep tuc luong dang ky
- Bo sung chuc nang chuot phai gan thiet bi vao ExpressVPN Group thu cong tren ca Form Dang ky va Form Login 2FA
